name: smallsteps
description: Explore an idea, assess its value and alternatives, and choose small next steps when you want a plan. Keep one Markdown note per idea, add a Mermaid map when useful, and create a Miro board on request.

interface.shortDescription: Explore an idea and find useful next steps
interface.longDescription: Explore an idea one question at a time, assess the problem, alternatives and evidence, and decide whether to proceed. When you want a plan, use the four questions to choose one useful result and a next action. Keep one Markdown note per idea, add a Mermaid map when useful, create a Miro board on request, and resume the idea later.
defaultPrompt: Use $smallsteps to turn my rough idea into a first small step.
Use $smallsteps to split this big idea into small results.
Use $smallsteps to resume my idea note and record what happened.
Use $smallsteps board to put my idea on a Miro board.
